<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_script"><sys_transform_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><map display_value="User skills transform map">732588eb2b2c075ca0e0f76a6e91bfe2</map><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target /*undefined onStart*/ ) {

if (!source.u_matched_skill || source.u_matched_skill.trim() == '') {
   ignore = true;
   return;
}

// 2. Find Resource
var userGR = new GlideRecord('x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_resource_profile'); 
userGR.addQuery('resource_name', source.u_name);
userGR.query();
if (!userGR.next()) {
   ignore = true;
   gs.log("User not found: " + source.u_name);
   return;
}

var skillGR = new GlideRecord('x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_skills');
skillGR.addQuery('name', source.u_matched_skill);
skillGR.query();
if (!skillGR.next()) {
   ignore = true;
   gs.log("Skill not found: " + source.u_matched_skill);
   return;
}
var dupCheck = new GlideRecord('x_kp101_kpmg_res_0_user_skill');
dupCheck.addQuery('user', userGR.sys_id);
dupCheck.addQuery('skill', skillGR.sys_id);
dupCheck.query();
if (dupCheck.hasNext()) {
   ignore = true;
   return;
}

target.u_resource = userGR.sys_id;
target.u_skill = skillGR.sys_id;


})(source, map, log, target);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_transform_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mdcadag</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-05 07:15:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>4426c0a32b6c075ca0e0f76a6e91bfbc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onBefore</sys_name><sys_package display_value="KPMG Resource Hub" source="x_kp101_kpmg_res_0">2d99e9272b948bd0a0e0f76a6e91bf71</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="KPMG Resource Hub">2d99e9272b948bd0a0e0f76a6e91bf71</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_script_4426c0a32b6c075ca0e0f76a6e91bfbc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mdcadag</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-05 07:15:08</sys_updated_on><when>onBefore</when></sys_transform_script></record_update>
